# no-duplicate-tags

Disallow duplicate tags on the same Gherkin element.

| Category | Recommended | Safe autofix | Default options |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| correctness | yes | no | none |

Finds duplicate tags on a Feature, Rule, Scenario, or Examples block.

## Configuration

```json
{ "rules": { "no-duplicate-tags": "error" } }
```

## Triggered by

```text
Feature: Login
  @smoke @smoke
  Scenario: valid login
```
